company_info.description: Yutaka Giken Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells automobile parts in Japan, North America, China, Asia, and internationally. The company offers torque converters; motor system; thermal management; brake system; exhaust system; and drive system. It also provides BELT POWER X, a work assistance device; M-BASE, general-purpose frame; and wind heating system for households. The company was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Hamamatsu, Japan.
